heading: The Characters
note: Backgrounds are being drawn from the book.

_schema.slug: stable id; used for the page URL and for photo links in photos.json
_schema.name: display name
_schema.aka: nickname, shown in quotes after the name (optional)
_schema.role: one line shown under the name on the home page (optional)
_schema.summary: list of strings; each becomes a paragraph on the character page
_schema.captions: optional {filename: caption} overrides for that person's photos
